comments.body: The latest Tidewater T2 shipment has arrived, but I need to report a serious delivery issue.

comments.author: Aisha Bell
comments.body: Cobalt Ridge Medical Center's second late Tidewater T2 delivery in three weeks arrived on 2026-08-22, four days behind schedule.

comments.author: Halvard Support
comments.body: We’ve logged the delivery complaint for review and will follow up with the shipping team.
